voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In July twenty fourteen, a German tourist named Lars Mittank arrived at Varna Airport, in Bulgaria, to fly home from a beach holiday.
He went to the airport doctor. He mentioned an injury from a fight days earlier, and asked for medication.
Then, on the security camera, he is seen dropping his luggage. He runs out of the terminal. He runs into a field of wheat.
He left his luggage, his phone, his wallet, and his passport inside the terminal.
beats.cap:
LUGGAGE, PHONE,
WALLET, PASSPORT
LEFT BEHIND

beats.vo: It is the most-viewed missing-person case in German history. The field was searched. The footage is unexplained.
